## Safety Checklist

- [ ] No secrets or account identifiers in artifacts.
- [ ] No package publishing, git push, production mutation, outbound email, financial transaction, secret rotation, or infrastructure destruction.
- [ ] Proof claims include evidence and exact statuses.
